Building Maintenance in Chennai

Professional Building Maintenance Services

K.G. Omegha provides professional building maintenance and facade maintenance services in Chennai and across Tamil Nadu. We work with commercial, residential, and industrial properties, delivering safe and reliable solutions for building exteriors and ongoing maintenance requirements.

Our services include facade glass cleaning, silicone application, ACP sheet fixing, pigeon net fixing, waterproofing, painting and protective coatings, structural repairs, and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC). Our team uses rope-access and other suitable access methods for high-rise and difficult-to-reach building areas.

Why Choose Us

Built on Trust

01

Rope Access & Safety

Certified rope access technicians and fully equipped suspended platforms ensure every high-rise job is executed with maximum safety compliance.

02

Safety Belts, Shoes & Gloves

We use safety belts, shoes & gloves while working. All materials are well checked before usage. We also install scaffolding when necessary.

03

Premium Materials Only

We use industry-leading silicon brands, weatherproof coatings, UV-resistant nets, and approved ACP panels from trusted manufacturers.

04

On-Time Delivery

Structured project timelines with dedicated site supervisors ensure your project is completed on schedule with zero compromise on quality.

05

Pan Tamil Nadu Reach

Operating across Chennai and all districts of Tamil Nadu — from Vellore to Coimbatore — bringing professional building maintenance wherever it's needed.
